$comment: First-load JavaScript budgets in brotli KB, enforced by scripts/size-budget.mjs.
Baseline measured on perf/build-hygiene-dead-assets-202 (issue #202) after epic #197
phases 1-4: shared floor 144.0 across 8 chunks, heaviest route 340.1
they came out identical against a full database and an empty one. The route count and
median are not, and move with how much content the build could see.
Each budget is the baseline plus roughly 5% of headroom. Raising one is allowed and
sometimes correct - say why in the PR, so the number keeps meaning something.
minSharedKb is the opposite direction: a shared floor BELOW it means the measurement
broke, not that the bundle shrank. Set well under the baseline so a genuine win
